title: Range Angle Calculator
source_docs: Phased Array System Toolbox/Environment and Target/Range_Angle_Calculator.md
text: 距离和角度计算，输入 3 路、输出 2 路；按 {Output(s)} 指定Output(s)；{Propagation model} 指定传播模型 Free、{Reference position source} 指定参考位置源、{Reference position} 指定参考位置、{Reference axes source} 指定参考轴源 Property、{Reference axes} 指定参考轴 eye、{Simulate using} 指定模块仿真方法 Interpreted，按实例取值。

ports.name: Pos
ports.summary: Source point position real-valued 3-by-1 vector | real-valued 3-by- N matrix

ports.name: RefPos
ports.summary: 参考点位置 [0;0;0] (default) | real-valued 3-by-1 vector | real-valued 3-by- N matrix

ports.name: RefAxes
ports.summary: 局部坐标系轴 [1 0 0;0 1 0;0 0 1] (default) | real-valued 3-by-3 vector | real-valued 3-by-3-by- N array

ports.name: Ang
ports.summary: 方位角和仰角 real-valued 2-by- N matrix | real-valued 2-by-2 N matrix

ports.name: Range
ports.summary: 传播距离 real-valued 1-by- N vector | real-valued 1-by-2 N vector

params.name: Propagation model
